name: vcf-framework
description: Vibe Coder Framework — 10-step doctrine, 8 gate commands, plus 15 cherry-picked utilities from gstack, GSD, Pocock, and Karpathy. Each gate reads upstream artifacts and writes its own, so /clear runs between every gate. v0.2.1 adds typeable slash commands (/vcf, /vcf-<gate>, /vcf-<utility>) as thin wrappers over the existing skills.
